items.text: We cut DeepSeek-V4 Pro startup from 8 minutes to under 2 minutes by moving weights over the fastest path to GPU memory with GPU-to-GPU RDMA. This was achieved using NVIDIA ModelExpress (MX), the weight distribution and cache management service in NVIDIA Dynamo, and this same approach speeds up both inference and RL post-training too. MX reuses kernel caches, while inference workers fetch updated weights directly from other GPUs over NIXL—avoiding centralized broadcasts and keeping weight movement off the critical path.
